facts.statement: The Trading Card Game's new expansion pack, Baron von Darkcheat, was announced as nearly released, with 146 new cards and new loot.
facts.quote: Colecione todas as 146 novas cartas e o novo saque

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - Quoi de neuf ? (JCC do Free Realms Prévia de Carta - Baron von Darckcheat!)
article_summaries.summary: A Portuguese-language preview on the Free Realms Trading Card Game (JCC) announcing the Baron von Darkcheat expansion and previewing the Order-sphere card Snowhill Defender. The page gives the expansion's card count and its story hook; it is a pre-release preview, not a record of the running game.
